text: Which lawyers in Melbourne are best for TPD and superannuation insurance claims?

result.keyword: Which lawyers in Melbourne are best for TPD and superannuation insurance claims?
result.markdown:
Yes. I searched specifically for **Melbourne lawyers specialising in TPD (Total and Permanent Disability), superannuation and insurance claims**, rather than general personal-injury firms.

There isn't an objective "best" lawyer, but based on specialist focus, experience, current client feedback, and the firms' published fee arrangements, **these are the Melbourne firms I'd shortlist**:

### 1. Berrill & Watson Lawyers Melbourne — my first choice for a specialist TPD/super claim
Berrill & Watson Lawyers Melbourne
[Web](https://www.berrillwatson.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
Address: level 1/650 Mt Alexander Rd, Moonee Ponds VIC 3039, Australia
Phone: +61394488048

**Why I'd put them at #1:** Berrill & Watson is unusually focused on **superannuation and insurance law**, rather than being a broad personal-injury practice. Principal Tom Cobban has more than 15 years working exclusively in superannuation and insurance claims, including TPD and income protection. [www.berrillwatson.com.au](https://www.berrillwatson.com.au/people/tom-cobban/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

They offer **free initial advice and no-win-no-fee**, and explicitly say they never represent insurance companies. [www.berrillwatson.com.au](https://www.berrillwatson.com.au/people/tom-cobban/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.berrillwatson.com.au](https://www.berrillwatson.com.au/about/tpd-victoria/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.berrillwatson.com.au](https://www.berrillwatson.com.au/about/what-our-clients-say/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.slatergordon.com.au](https://www.slatergordon.com.au/people/william-matthews?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Their Melbourne office currently has **5.0/5 from 316 reviews** in the business listing, and their own site contains a large number of recent positive TPD/superannuation reviews, including reviews from 2026. [www.berrillwatson.com.au](https://www.berrillwatson.com.au/about/what-our-clients-say/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[Berrill & Watson — TPD Lawyers Melbourne](https://www.berrillwatson.com.au/about/tpd-victoria/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for:** a complicated TPD claim, rejected/delayed claim, multiple insurance policies, income protection + TPD, or someone who wants a genuine super/insurance specialist.

---

### 2. LHD Lawyers Melbourne — strong specialist alternative
LHD Lawyers Melbourne
[Web](https://www.lhd.com.au/office-location/vic/melbourne/?utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=melbourne&utm_source=chatgpt.com)
Address: Level 9/555 Lonsdale St, Melbourne VIC 3000, Australia
Phone: +611300273248

LHD has a dedicated Melbourne **TPD & superannuation claims** practice and advertises 35+ years of experience, no-win-no-fee arrangements and a 99% win-rate claim. [www.lhd.com.au](https://www.lhd.com.au/office-location/vic/melbourne/tpd-superannuation-claims/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Their Melbourne listing currently shows **4.9/5 from 170 reviews**, which is a substantial review base. 

[LHD — Melbourne TPD & Superannuation Claims](https://www.lhd.com.au/office-location/vic/melbourne/tpd-superannuation-claims/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for:** someone wanting a large specialist claims operation with a strong Melbourne review profile.

---

### 3. Maurice Blackburn Personal Injury Lawyers Melbourne — strong large-firm option
Maurice Blackburn Personal Injury Lawyers Melbourne
[Web](https://www.mauriceblackburn.com.au/our-offices/vic/melbourne/?utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=gmb-website&utm_content=website_button&utm_term=plcid_4752754200758419732&utm_source=chatgpt.com)
Address: 21/380 La Trobe St, Melbourne VIC 3000, Australia
Phone: +61396052700

Maurice Blackburn has a dedicated **superannuation and insurance claims** team in Melbourne. Laura Davies has more than 10 years' experience specifically in superannuation and insurance, covering TPD, income protection, trauma, life/death and salary-continuance claims. [www.mauriceblackburn.com.au](https://www.mauriceblackburn.com.au/our-lawyers/laura-davies/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Their Melbourne TPD team includes Principal Lawyer Hayriye Uluca, who leads the Victorian superannuation/insurance litigation practice. [www.mauriceblackburn.com.au](https://www.mauriceblackburn.com.au/injury-illness/superannuation-insurance-claims/total-permanent-disability-melbourne/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

The Melbourne office has a substantial review footprint: **4.6/5 from 495 reviews** in the current business listing.

[Maurice Blackburn — Melbourne TPD claims](https://www.mauriceblackburn.com.au/injury-illness/superannuation-insurance-claims/total-permanent-disability-melbourne/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for:** someone who prefers a large, established firm and wants access to a substantial specialist team.

---

### 4. Law Partners Injury Lawyers Melbourne — worth getting a quote from
Law Partners Injury Lawyers Melbourne
[Web](https://lawpartners.com.au/offices/personal-injury-lawyers-melbourne?utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=gbp-melbourne&utm_source=chatgpt.com)
Address: Level 14/114 William St, Melbourne VIC 3000, Australia
Phone: +61384003100

Law Partners has a dedicated Victorian TPD/superannuation practice and says it has helped thousands of Australians with TPD claims. It offers **no-win-no-fee with no disbursements**, according to its published terms. [lawpartners.com.au](https://lawpartners.com.au/vic/superannuation-tpd-lawyers?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Its Melbourne listing currently shows **4.8/5 from 83 reviews**.

[Law Partners — Melbourne TPD Lawyers](https://lawpartners.com.au/vic/superannuation-tpd-lawyers?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for:** comparing a specialist firm's costs against the more boutique Berrill & Watson option.

---

### 5. Withstand Lawyers — boutique/specialist option
Withstand Lawyers

Withstand is particularly interesting because it says its lawyers handle TPD and superannuation claims as a dedicated practice, with particular lawyers working **exclusively in TPD and superannuation**. Its site currently reports **4.9/5 from 265+ verified Google reviews** and a no-win-no-fee model. [www.withstandlawyers.com.au](https://www.withstandlawyers.com.au/tpd-lawyers-melbourne/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[Withstand Lawyers — Melbourne TPD Lawyers](https://www.withstandlawyers.com.au/tpd-lawyers-melbourne/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for:** someone wanting a smaller specialist team and direct attention from lawyers specialising in TPD.

---

### What about Slater & Gordon?

Slater and Gordon is also a very credible option. Its Melbourne team specifically handles **superannuation, disability insurance, TPD and income-protection claims**, and it offers no-win-no-fee arrangements. [www.slatergordon.com.au](https://www.slatergordon.com.au/people/william-matthews?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[Slater & Gordon — TPD claims](https://www.slatergordon.com.au/superannuation-and-insurance/total-and-permanent-disability-tpd-claims?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

I'd put them in the **"definitely worth getting a competing quote/opinion"** category rather than automatically choosing them over the more specialised Berrill & Watson.

## My ranking

| Rank | Firm | My take |
|---|---|---|
| 🥇 | **Berrill & Watson** | **Best specialist choice** |
| 🥈 | **LHD** | Excellent specialist alternative |
| 🥉 | **Maurice Blackburn** | Best large established firm option |
| 4 | **Withstand** | Strong boutique/specialist alternative |
| 5 | **Law Partners** | Strong option, particularly worth comparing fees |
| 6 | **Slater & Gordon** | Very established and experienced |


**If this were my claim, I'd speak to Berrill & Watson and one of LHD/Withstand before signing anything.** TPD cases can turn heavily on the exact policy wording, the date your cover was active, medical evidence and whether the applicable test is "own occupation" or "any occupation." [www.berrillwatson.com.au](https://www.berrillwatson.com.au/supertalk-blog/2026/january/common-challenges-tpd-claims/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

One important point: **don't choose solely on "no win, no fee."** Ask each firm for the actual costs agreement, including legal fees, medical/report costs, barrister costs if applicable, and what happens if the claim is unsuccessful.

If you tell me **whether your TPD claim is (1) not yet lodged, (2) already lodged, (3) rejected, or (4) in dispute/appeal**, I can narrow this down to the **2–3 Melbourne lawyers I'd contact first** and compare their fees, success/review evidence and experience with cases like yours.

items.markdown:
Yes. I searched specifically for **Melbourne lawyers specialising in TPD (Total and Permanent Disability), superannuation and insurance claims**, rather than general personal-injury firms.

There isn't an objective "best" lawyer, but based on specialist focus, experience, current client feedback, and the firms' published fee arrangements, **these are the Melbourne firms I'd shortlist**:

### 1. Berrill & Watson Lawyers Melbourne — my first choice for a specialist TPD/super claim
Berrill & Watson Lawyers Melbourne
[Web](https://www.berrillwatson.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
Address: level 1/650 Mt Alexander Rd, Moonee Ponds VIC 3039, Australia
Phone: +61394488048

**Why I'd put them at #1:** Berrill & Watson is unusually focused on **superannuation and insurance law**, rather than being a broad personal-injury practice. Principal Tom Cobban has more than 15 years working exclusively in superannuation and insurance claims, including TPD and income protection. [www.berrillwatson.com.au](https://www.berrillwatson.com.au/people/tom-cobban/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

They offer **free initial advice and no-win-no-fee**, and explicitly say they never represent insurance companies. [www.berrillwatson.com.au](https://www.berrillwatson.com.au/people/tom-cobban/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.berrillwatson.com.au](https://www.berrillwatson.com.au/about/tpd-victoria/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.berrillwatson.com.au](https://www.berrillwatson.com.au/about/what-our-clients-say/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.slatergordon.com.au](https://www.slatergordon.com.au/people/william-matthews?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Their Melbourne office currently has **5.0/5 from 316 reviews** in the business listing, and their own site contains a large number of recent positive TPD/superannuation reviews, including reviews from 2026. [www.berrillwatson.com.au](https://www.berrillwatson.com.au/about/what-our-clients-say/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[Berrill & Watson — TPD Lawyers Melbourne](https://www.berrillwatson.com.au/about/tpd-victoria/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

items.markdown:
**If this were my claim, I'd speak to Berrill & Watson and one of LHD/Withstand before signing anything.** TPD cases can turn heavily on the exact policy wording, the date your cover was active, medical evidence and whether the applicable test is "own occupation" or "any occupation." [www.berrillwatson.com.au](https://www.berrillwatson.com.au/supertalk-blog/2026/january/common-challenges-tpd-claims/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

One important point: **don't choose solely on "no win, no fee."** Ask each firm for the actual costs agreement, including legal fees, medical/report costs, barrister costs if applicable, and what happens if the claim is unsuccessful.

If you tell me **whether your TPD claim is (1) not yet lodged, (2) already lodged, (3) rejected, or (4) in dispute/appeal**, I can narrow this down to the **2–3 Melbourne lawyers I'd contact first** and compare their fees, success/review evidence and experience with cases like yours.
